description: This file defines 'VoiceWakeRuntime', an actor responsible for managing voice wake word detection, speech recognition, and related audio processing within a macOS application. It handles starting/stopping recognition, processing audio buffers, managing recognition state, and integrating with other app components for voice command handling.

classes.name: VoiceWakeRuntime
classes.description: An actor responsible for managing voice wake word detection, speech recognition, and related audio processing within the app.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates the recognition runtime based on the current application state, starting or stopping recognition as needed.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition pipeline with a specific configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the recognition pipeline and clears relevant resources.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures the speech recognizer with the specified locale.

methods.name: handleRecognition
methods.description: Processes recognition results, handling triggers, managing capture state, and updating overlays.

methods.name: maybeLogRecognition
methods.description: Logs recognition transcripts and match details for debugging.

methods.name: noteAudioTap
methods.description: Logs the RMS audio level for each audio tap.

methods.name: noteRecognitionCallback
methods.description: Logs recognition callback results.

methods.name: scheduleTriggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Schedules a check to pause recognition if only trigger words are detected.

methods.name: schedulePreDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Schedules a check for silence detection to trigger fallback recognition.

methods.name: triggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Checks if recognition should be paused when only trigger words are detected.

methods.name: isTriggerOnly
methods.description: Determines if the transcript contains only trigger words.

methods.name: preDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Checks for silence fallback detection based on audio levels.

methods.name: beginCapture
methods.description: Starts the voice command capture process, handling both prompt-based and trigger-only modes.

methods.name: monitorCapture
methods.description: Monitors ongoing audio capture, stopping after silence or max duration.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Finalizes and processes the captured voice command, updating overlays and forwarding transcripts.

methods.name: noteAudioLevel
methods.description: Updates the adaptive noise floor and visual levels based on audio RMS.

methods.name: restartRecognizer
methods.description: Restarts the recognition engine to listen for new triggers.

methods.name: restartRecognizerIfIdleAndOverlayHidden
methods.description: Restarts recognizer if idle and overlay is hidden.

methods.name: scheduleRestartRecognizer
methods.description: Schedules a recognizer restart with optional delay.

methods.name: consumeScheduledRestart
methods.description: Clears scheduled restart task.

methods.name: applyPushToTalkCooldown
methods.description: Sets a cooldown period after a push-to-talk command.

methods.name: pauseForPushToTalk
methods.description: Pauses recognition to handle push-to-talk.

methods.name: updateHeardBeyondTrigger
methods.description: Marks that speech was heard beyond the trigger word.

methods.name: trimmedAfterTrigger
methods.description: Returns the text after the trigger word.

methods.name: commandAfterTrigger
methods.description: Extracts the command text following trigger words, considering trigger end time if provided.
